thread:
yasmin_sales: Quick presales Q for prospect 'AquaLane' — must keep inference + logs + keys in EU or CA per tenant. Prefer hosted if we can guarantee no cross-border egress even for failover. Need uplift %, timeline, and whether we can show egress by-tenant in billing.

pablo_engineer: Hosted supports tenant-pin to eu/ca pools. We can set fallback to 'none' to prevent cross-border failover, but availability risk goes up. Model cache and inference stay regionally pinned. Control plane metadata is global unless Private.

rachel_privsec: Legal will ask for subprocessor roster (eu/ca), BYO-KMS support, and written attestation that audit logs & keys don't leave the region. If control-plane contact with keys is possible cross-region, need key-policy adjustments or regional key-proxy.

noah_ops: Ops can provision regional pools and regional log sinks. Timeline: hosted pin + pools ~10 business days. KMS proxy if needed +5 business days. Dedicated reduces outage risk but needs finance/commit.

yasmin_sales: Can we present pricing as a simple uplift? Customer wants a single-line delta.

pablo_engineer: Ballpark: hosted hard-pin (no-fallback) + ~18% usage uplift (packing + reserved headroom). Dedicated per-region reduce unit delta but adds monthly commit. Private/control-plane-in-region is multi-week + infra fee.

noah_ops: We can also produce tenant-level egress reports for billing—ops will tag flows and generate a CSV. Add-on: per-tenant egress alerting available.

rachel_privsec: I'll draft a short DPA paragraph and subprocessor list. If AquaLane insists absolutely zero global control-plane access to keys, recommend Dedicated/Private.

yasmin_sales: Perfect. I'll send SOW options: A) Hosted hard-pin +18% uplift + 10bd lead, B) Dedicated/reserved pricing (TBD). Tagging @rachel_privsec for DPA. Thanks :thumbsup:
